heading: How we work
intro: We plan before we build. Every project moves through the same five steps.

steps.title: Understand the business
steps.description: We start with a conversation about what your business actually does and where it’s losing time or customers. Not a feature list — the problem underneath it.

steps.title: Plan and scope
steps.description: We map out what needs building and why, then put it in writing: what you’re getting, how long it takes, what it costs. Nothing starts until that’s agreed.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We design the structure and the interface before writing code. You see it, comment on it, and change it while changing it is still cheap.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Regular progress you can look at and respond to. No disappearing for six weeks and hoping it’s what you wanted.

steps.title: Launch and after
steps.description: Deployment, handover, training your team if needed — and support once it’s live.
